title: Sami Potta Mudichu
desc: Kadhirvelan wishes to take revenge on his uncle, who is responsible for his grandfather's death. However, he changes his mind after he meets Neelaveni, his uncle's daughter.

title: Padum Vanambadi
desc: Anand, a dance enthusiast, rises to popularity as a disco dancer after taking lessons from his uncle. Annoyed by his success, his rival hatches a plan to defeat him.

title: Ganga Gowri
desc: Shiva, who is in love with Ganga, must marry another woman to pay off his debt. However, what begins as a marriage of necessity quickly evolves into something more.

title: Jallikattu Kaalai
desc: Gopalkrishnan, an ordinary mill worker, falls in love with the mill owner's daughter. However, a vicious landlord causes a stir in their lives.
